results.description: The JWST Little Red Dots Could Be 'Black Hole Stars' Universe Today Black hole star: Astronomers discover a brand-new type of astrophysical object Phys.org A gas-enshrouded and gas-reddened black hole at cosmic dawn Nature JWST spotted an object 660 million years after the Big Bang that looks like a star the size of our solar system but shines 100 billion times brighter than any star — and the only thing that could explain it is a black hole wrapped inside Space Daily New space object ‘black hole star’ discovered by astronomers CTV News
